bias.en: Rebound · holding the 30-day, under the 200-day and $388
bias.zh: 反弹 · 守住 30 日均线，仍低于 200 日均线和 $388

read.en: Tesla rose 0.5% on Nov 10 to $379.78, trading $370.43–380.00 on light volume (0.59x the 20-day average). It is above the 5-day ($369.0), 30-day ($378.0) and 100-day ($366.4) and below the 10-day ($385.5) and 200-day ($383.2); only the 30-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5, above zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 ($404.78), and RSI is 50.
read.zh: 特斯拉 11月10日上涨 0.5%，收于 $379.78，盘中区间 $370.43–380.00，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.59 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$369.0）、30 日（$378.0）和 100 日（$366.4）均线上方，10 日（$385.5）和 200 日（$383.2）均线下方；仅 30 日均线在上行。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方，在零轴上方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看空（$404.78），RSI 为 50。

read.en: No level changed: the close held above the 30-day ($378.0), and the $380 high stayed under the $382.2–383.2 resistance. Resistance is $382.2–383.2 (Nov 9 high, 200-day), then $385.5–388.6 (10-day, $388 cap, Oct 9 high) and $404.8–414.2 (SAR, Nov 2 high). Support is $369–378 (5 and 30-day, Nov 10 low), then $366.4–368.1 (100-day, Oct 19 close) and $345.9–349.3. A close above $383.2 would target $388; below $369, $366–368.
